messages:
tia: quick heads-up from a short accessibility sweep on the Models grid (compact mode). Found a few keyboard + SR regressions. attaching notes + screenshots.

raju: thanks — can you list repro steps? i'll try on linux + NVDA.

tia: repro: 
1) open Models > Grid view > toggle Compact
2) tab to row, press Enter to open the kebab menu (⋯)
3) use ArrowDown to move between menu items, Hit Esc to close
4) toggle dark theme and tab through the row actions
Issues I saw: 
- focus disappears on Esc (doesn't return to row trigger)
- kebab has role missing (no aria-haspopup/expanded) so SR reads nothing
- menu itself uses divs, needs role="menu" + menuitems
- copy ID icon is not keyboard-able in compact mode (no button)
- status chips in dark theme have low contrast (chip text #9CA3AF on #0F172A is ~3.1:1)
- focus-visible is subtle in dark mode (outline almost invisible)

leo: confirmed on Windows/NVDA: when the menu closes focus jumps to the search input in the toolbar. Looks like focus-management is global and using document.activeElement fallback.

ada: for the missing roles we should add aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded binding on the trigger. For the menu DOM use <ul role="menu"> and <li role="menuitem"> for items to get proper SR semantics.

raju: short-term fixes we can ship in a patch: 
- make kebab a <button aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false"> and bind aria-expanded on open
- menu container: role="menu" and add tabindex="-1" so we can focus it programmatically
- on close, call trigger.focus({preventScroll: true}) to restore focus
- convert copy icon to <button aria-label="Copy model id">
- bump focus-visible style in dark tokens: outline-color: #60A5FA; outline-width: 3px; outline-style: solid

tia: color proposal for chips: keep bg #0B1220 (existing) but change text to #E6EEF8 which is ~8.0:1 on that bg. minimal visual change but big contrast win.

leo: sounds good. Also add a unit/integration test: keyboard nav from trigger -> open menu -> arrow to 2nd item -> Esc -> expect focus on trigger. We can add an axe check for chip contrast in storybook CI.

ada: one more small accessibility nit: table headers in grid fallback lack scope attributes. add scope="col" on header cells and ensure sorted columns get aria-sort="ascending|descending".

a11y-bot: Scan result (218 items scanned): 5 failures, 4 warnings. Top failures: role-less menu, non-interactive copy icon, insufficient contrast on chips (dark theme). Full report: https://a11y.internal/reports/218-compact-grid

raju: timeline: i'll open a minimal PR today (label: patch/a11y). if reviewers sign off we can ship a hotfix tomorrow. I'll include tests and axe job.

tia: i'll update the design token PR for dark focus + chip text color and drop screenshots into the PR description.

leo: i'll run manual VoiceOver & NVDA checks post-PR and confirm. If all green i'll approve for hotfix. thanks team. :rocket:
